name: PersonalQA-71-100
description: A synthetic benchmark designed to simulate a realistic user's digital footprint and evaluate the performance of EpisTwin, a neuro-symbolic framework for personal AI that grounds generative reasoning in a user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph.
reputation: A synthetic personal-knowledge benchmark used primarily to evaluate the EpisTwin framework, with limited standalone community adoption.
notes: Synthetic benchmark simulating user digital footprint; evaluates complex reasoning over personal semantic graphs using multimodal inputs.
